description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted to introduce No. 39 Suil Na Habhann, Mill Road  Corbally to the market. This spacious three storey semi-detached home is ideally located in the  popular and well-established residential area of Corbally.
The property is located  within an easy stroll to  local cafés, bars, and a wide range of sports and recreational facilities. An excellent selection of both primary and secondary schools are nearby, along with good public transport links, while Limerick City Centre is only a short drive away.
No. 39 offers bright and spacious accommodation comprising  of a bright, spacious front reception room,  an open plan kitchen/dining room, utility room  and a downstairs guest Wc.  Upstairs, on the 1st floor there is the main bathroom and three generous bedrooms with an ensuite off the main bedroom. The 2nd floor has a further 2 bedrooms giving ample spacious accommodation. 
To the front of the property there is a lawned garden and driveway, while to the rear is a spacious garden and patio ideal for family living or future extension.
Built in 2001 the property features gas-fired central heating, double-glazed PVC  windows, and mains water and sewage.
Overall floor area: approx. 148.7sq.m / 1600sq.ft
Included in sale: Carpets, curtains, blinds, double oven, hob expelair, washing machine & tumble dryer, light fittings (with the exception of the light fitting in the front reception room & the light in the diningroom over the dining table.) 
Viewing is highly recommended.
